components.name: Same-base predictor and corrector with fresh samples

limitations.statement: The recorded performance concerns the mean of predictors for this selected Algorithm. It is not a lower bound or unrestricted Oracle Complexity characterization.
No performance guarantee for reused samples, inexact prox, last-iterate output or adaptive stopping is extracted here.

setup.geometry: ω:Z→R is continuous convex; Z°={z:∂ω(z)≠∅} admits a continuous selection ω' with <ω'(z)-ω'(z'),z-z'>≥||z-z'||². V(z,u)=ω(u)-ω(z)-<ω'(z),u-z>; zc=argmin_Z ω; Ω²=2 max_{u∈Z}V(zc,u). P_z(ξ)=argmin_{u∈Z}{V(z,u)+<ξ,u>}∈Z°.
setup.oracle: Ξ is Borel and each call uses a fresh iid ζ, independent of the preceding history. Uniformly for z∈Z, ||E[Ξ(z,ζ)-F(z)]||_*≤μ and E||Ξ(z,ζ)-F(z)||_*²≤σ², μ,σ≥0.
setup.space_and_operator: Finite-dimensional Euclidean E with norm ||·|| and dual ||·||_*. Z⊂E is nonempty compact convex; F:Z→E is bounded monotone and satisfies ||F(z)-F(z')||_*≤L||z-z'||+M for every z,z'∈Z, L,M≥0.

variants.cost: Exactly 2t SO calls and 2t exact prox minimizations, plus center computation at initialization, predictor accumulation and averaging. These are separate resources; no dimension-independent arithmetic cost for prox, center computation or sampling is asserted.
variants.implementation_details_ref: PDF p.7 prox definition; p.8 §3.3 Algorithm 1 equations (19)–(21); p.9 §3.4 constant-step policy and Theorem 1(i)
variants.name: Fresh-sample SMP, constant-step expected-gap variant
variants.output: z_hat_t=(1/t)Σ_{τ=1}^t wτ∈Z; predictor average, not final corrector r_t.
public_inputs: Z, norm, distance generator and continuous subgradient selection, exact prox implementation and center zc
SO access; fixed positive integer horizon t; known L and positive constant γ satisfying √3 Lγ≤1
variants.query_and_update: For τ=1,…,t: query aτ=Ξ(r_{τ-1},ζ_{2τ-1}); set wτ=P_{r_{τ-1}}(γaτ). Then query bτ=Ξ(wτ,ζ_{2τ}) using a new sample; set rτ=P_{r_{τ-1}}(γbτ). Both prox steps use r_{τ-1}, not wτ, as base.
variants.requirements: The complete geometry, model and uniform SO conditions in content.setup. Both prox minimizations are exact. Each new oracle sample is independent of all prior samples and the pre-call history; the responses themselves need not be mutually independent because query points are adaptive.
variants.state_and_initialization: Compute zc=argmin_{u∈Z}ω(u) and set r0=zc∈Z°. Maintain r_{τ-1} and the running sum of predictor points.
variants.tuning_and_stopping: Fix t and γ before running; require γ>0 and √3 Lγ≤1. For L=0 this condition imposes no finite upper cap on γ. Execute exactly t iterations. The general source Algorithm uses a weighted average; the selected constant-step variant uses an arithmetic mean. No optimized-step or adaptive-stop claim is included.
